reviews.text:
I can't say anything else...a top-notch groomer.
Our two little dragons go in without fear.
Doortje, our ADHD Shih Tzu, is expertly groomed, and we also receive good advice and tips.
I can only give her a 10 out of 10.
Skilled and professional, we are allowed to stay with them and my wife is even allowed to help, which she really enjoys; our Roos always looks perfect, we will definitely be back.

I arrived exactly on time for my appointment. Ramona was outside on the phone while her dog was running loose. My dog ​​(in a basket on the back of my bike) was almost immediately attacked by her dog. Ramona then struggled to drag her dog inside, and I received a very irritated response because I mentioned something about the "friendly welcome." Then the "dog lover lady" announced that she refused to groom my dog. As if it would even occur to me to leave my dog ​​there after this kind of reception. In short, never bring your dog here. Thanks, but no thanks.
Neat, can always be met at short notice, also very sweet to Lizzy and Storm

Went to Diva's & Draakjes for the first time.
I was able to stay with them, which was handy because my little poodle was (almost) unmanageable. 🫣 …

My dog just got a very nice short cut today for a fair price. Thanks guys!
The pin on the map is not exactly accurate, you need to walk until the end of that small street, where you see number 16.

I went for the first time today, after years at another salon, so it was nerve-wracking... but what a sweet and skilled woman Ramona is! Glad I found her, dog is happy, owner is too, and of course I immediately booked a new appointment for next time. Highly recommended as far as I'm concerned!

I had been here once with my little dog. When I went to pick up my dog ​​because I received a call saying he was ready, she reacted irritably when we walked right in because she wasn't finished yet and my dog ​​was happy to see us. …
